F1将于周六在阿塞拜疆比赛，这项运动重返巴库城市赛道，这里往往是赛季中事故最多的分站之一。
作为飞往马来西亚和新加坡的三连赛首站，巴库比赛周末比平时提前一天开始，意味着练习赛在周四，排位赛在周五，正赛在周六。

但是，正如当时的积分榜领先者奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里（皮亚斯特里）在去年比赛中付出的代价所示，围墙林立的巴库赛道一旦犯错就会咬人，这条快速而棘手的赛道在排位赛和正赛日都充满挑战。
回顾巴库城市赛道发生过的一些最戏剧性的时刻
巴库正赛比平时提前一天在周六（9月26日）举行，因为9月27日周日是该国的纪念日。
这意味着2026年的正赛在周六举行，排位赛在周五，前两节练习赛在周四。
阿塞拜疆比英国快三小时，因此各节比赛比欧洲赛季期间略早，排位赛在下午1点，正赛在中午12点。
巴库城市赛道2025年阿塞拜疆大奖赛集锦
在这个欧洲与亚洲交汇、位于里海之滨的国家，巴库城市赛道于2016年加入F1赛历。首年比赛以欧洲大奖赛的名义举办，从次年起改用该国名称，是这项运动较快的街道赛道之一。
这种速度在车手沿1.4英里长的主直道时速超过200英里时最为明显——这是全赛季最长的直道——尾流和超车机会众多，赛车最多可三车并排。2018年，红牛队友马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘）和丹尼尔·里卡多（Daniel Ricciardo）在一号弯大力刹车区发生碰撞。
经过两条由经典街道赛道式90度弯连接的较短直道后，这条3.7英里的赛道进入古城蜿蜒区域，包括全赛季最窄的一段赛道。8号9号弯之间棘手的“城堡”减速弯护栏间距仅7.6米，F1赛车由此经过该市受联合国教科文组织保护的中世纪区域。
比赛周天气预计温暖干燥，最高气温在25度左右。

detailEn: Azerbaijan GP 2026: Saturday race, dates, schedule, Baku weather, UK start time and how to watch or stream F1 live on Sky Sports

Find out the race-week schedule, weather and how to watch the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend in Baku; watch the Baku race on Saturday at 12pm, with build-up from 10.30am, on Sky Sports F1 and Sky Sports Main Event
Craig Slater breaks down the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, including why the race takes place on a Saturday, while doing his best Craig David impression!
Formula 1 is racing in Azerbaijan on Saturday as the sport returns to the Baku City Circuit for what often proves one of the season's most incident-filled events.

The first round of a flyaway triple header before trips to Malaysia and Singapore, the Baku race weekend starts a day earlier than normal meaning Practice is on Thursday, Qualifying is on Friday and the Grand Prix is on Saturday.

Kimi Antonelli leads the world championship by 81 points after consecutive wins in Monza and Madrid and time is running out for his would-be title challengers to put a run together to rival him with a scheduled eight rounds left after Baku.

But, as then-title leader Oscar Piastri found to his cost at last year's race, the wall-lined Baku circuit can certainly bite if you make a mistake with challenges present all round the fast and tricky layout for both qualifying and race day.
Look back at some of the most dramatic moments to have taken place around the Baku City Circuit
The Baku race takes place a day earlier than normal on a Saturday (September 26) as it is the country's Remembrance Day on Sunday September 27.
That means 2026's Grand Prix takes is being held on Saturday, with Qualifying on Friday and the opening two practice sessions on Thursday.
Azerbaijan is three hours ahead of the UK so the sessions are slightly earlier than they were during the European season, with Qualifying at 1pm and the Grand Prix at midday.
Highlights of the 2025 Azerbaijan Grand Prix from the Baku City Circuit

In the country on the Caspian Sea where Europe meets Asia, the Baku City Circuit joined the F1 calendar in 2016. The race ran under the European Grand Prix title in that first year, before taking the country's name from the following season, and is one of the breed of the sport's faster street tracks.

That speed is no more evident than when drivers top 200mph down the 1.4-mile long main straight - the longest of the whole season - with slipstreaming and overtaking opportunities aplenty as cars go up to three abreast. The big Turn One braking zone was the scene of a crash between Red Bull team-mates Max Verstappen and Daniel Ricciardo in 2018.

After two shorter straights connected by classic street circuit-style 90-degree turns, the 3.7-mile track heads into the twister ancient part of the city, including the narrowest piece of track of the whole season. At 7.6 metres between the barriers, the tricky Turn Eight-Nine 'castle' chicane takes F1 cars past what is the city's UNESCO-protected medieval area.
Weather conditions are set to be warm and dry throughout race week, with temperature highs in the mid-20s.

detailEn: United States GP: Lewis Hamilton fastest from Max Verstappen in final practice ahead of Qualifying in Austin

Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton outpaced Red Bull's Max Verstappen in final practice in Austin with Friday's pace-setter Charles Leclerc in third; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 10pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
Lewis Hamilton claims the fastest lap from Max Verstappen in final practice at the United States Grand Prix
Lewis Hamilton topped final practice from Max Verstappen at the United States Grand Prix to set up a tantalising qualifying in Austin.
Hamilton was 0.168s quicker than Verstappen as Ferrari and Red Bull look set to fight for pole position and victory for a second consecutive weekend.
Charles Leclerc topped both of Friday's sessions and had set the quickest time in final practice by one tenth from Hamilton, only for it to be deleted due to track limits.

Track limits is set to be a major issue for the drivers in qualifying, which takes place at 10pm UK time later on Saturday (build-up from 8.30pm live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event) due to the tarmac run-off areas and the drivers keen to use every bit of track to gain lap time.

Leclerc still finished the session in third, ahead of championship leader Kimi Antonelli whose chances of becoming the youngest world champion look extremely difficult, given he must first win the Grand Prix to give himself an opportunity, and Mercedes are a tad off the pace.
Antonelli was three tenths behind Hamilton's pace-setting time with his Mercedes team-mate George Russell in fifth at nearly half a second down.

McLaren's Lando Norris was eighth but would have been in the top five had his best lap not been deleted for track limit, while Oscar Piastri was sixth and Audi's Nico Hulkenberg impressing in seventh.
